source_refs.note: 'Research Questions and Hypotheses' under topic 7.1, as printed (PDF 94, printed 90).

blocks.text: Research questions define what is being studied. A hypothesis is formed from the research question. Questions guide data collection. Hypotheses provide possible answers. Clear questions lead to clear hypotheses. Both are closely connected. Good research starts with good questions. Hypotheses make the analysis focused. They improve study direction.
